0 FILE L_Arrivee_Master.mpd
0 Name: L'Arrivee (The Arrival)
0 Author: Grace Balanced Architect
0 !LDRAW_ORG Model
0 !LICENCE Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0
0 BFC CERTIFY CCW

0 // =================================================================
0 // SCENE: L'Arrivee d'un train en gare de La Ciotat (1895)
0 // CONCEPT: A study in scale and panic. The Duplo engine vs System crowd.
 
0 // =================================================================

0 STEP
0 // 1. THE IRON HORSE (The Threat)
0 // Placement: X=-160 (Left Field), Y=0 (Ground), Z=Centered
1 16 -160 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 The_Locomotive.ldr

0 STEP
0 // 2. THE STATION ARCHITECTURE (The Frame)
0 // Placement: X=100 (Right Field), Y=0 (Ground)
1 16 100 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 The_Station.ldr

0 STEP
0 // 3. THE PANIC (The Reaction)
0 // Placement: Scattered on Platform
1 16 100 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 The_Crowd.ldr

0 NOFILE
0 FILE The_Locomotive.ldr
0 Name: The Duplo Engine
0 Author: Grace
0 !LDRAW_ORG Model
0 BFC CERTIFY CCW

0 // -- THE TRACKS --
0 // Train Track Ramps (85977) providing the vector
1 7 0 0 -400 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/85977.dat
1 7 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/85977.dat
1 7 0 0 400 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/85977.dat

0 // -- THE CHASSIS (Duplo Scale) --
0 // Duplo Car Bases (14639) - Massive scale implies weight
0 // Color 0 (Black) for the heavy iron look
1 0 0 -50 -300 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/14639p01.dat
1 0 0 -50 0 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/14639p01.dat
1 0 0 -50 300 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/14639p01.dat

0 // -- THE FACE (Cowcatcher) --
0 // Facet Brick (14413) mounted on front
1 72 0 -60 -450 0 0 -1 0 1 0 1 0 0 parts/14413.dat

0 // -- THE PNEUMATICS --
0 // Piping details along the side
1 71 -60 -70 0 0 0 1 1 0 0 0 1 0 parts/14653-f1.dat
1 71 60 -70 0 0 0 1 1 0 0 0 1 0 parts/14653-f1.dat

0 // -- THE STEAM --
0 // Palm Leaves (2518) rotated to explode outwards from wheels
0 // White (15) for steam
1 15 50 0 -200 0 0 1 0.7 0.7 0 -0.7 0.7 0 parts/2518.dat
1 15 -50 0 -200 0 0 -1 -0.7 0.7 0 0.7 0.7 0 parts/2518.dat
1 15 50 0 200 0 0 1 0.7 0.7 0 -0.7 0.7 0 parts/2518.dat
1 15 -50 0 200 0 0 -1 -0.7 0.7 0 0.7 0.7 0 parts/2518.dat

0 NOFILE
0 FILE The_Station.ldr
0 Name: La Ciotat Platform
0 Author: Grace
0 !LDRAW_ORG Model
0 BFC CERTIFY CCW

0 // -- THE PLATFORM FLOOR --
0 // Train Bases (303c01) laid flat. Texture = Tiled Floor.
0 // Tan (19)
1 19 100 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/303c01.dat
1 19 100 0 300 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/303c01.dat
1 19 100 0 -300 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/303c01.dat

0 // -- THE GASLIGHTS --
0 // Lampposts (2039) establishing the Z-axis depth
1 0 80 0 -250 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/2039.dat
1 0 80 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/2039.dat
1 0 80 0 250 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/2039.dat

0 // -- THE SKY VAULT (Roof) --
0 // Inverted Boat Hull (18913) - Floating suspension
0 // Trans-Dark Blue (43) for "Iron and Glass" feel
1 43 150 -400 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 0 0 0 1 parts/18913.dat
0 // Secondary Ribs (28535)
1 72 300 -350 -300 -1 0 0 0 -1 0 0 0 1 parts/28535.dat
1 72 300 -350 300 -1 0 0 0 -1 0 0 0 1 parts/28535.dat

0 // -- THE WALL --
0 // Technic Panels (64393)
1 72 250 -50 0 0 0 1 1 0 0 0 1 0 parts/64393.dat

0 NOFILE
0 FILE The_Crowd.ldr
0 Name: The Terrified Audience
0 Author: Grace
0 !LDRAW_ORG Model
0 BFC CERTIFY CCW

0 // -- FIGURE 1: THE FALL (Front Row) --
0 // Tipping backwards (Rotated on X)
0 // Hips
1 4 40 -10 0 1 0 0 0 0.866 0.5 0 -0.5 0.866 parts/10679b.dat
0 // Torso
1 4 40 -40 10 1 0 0 0 0.866 0.5 0 -0.5 0.866 parts/10677.dat
0 // Head (Screaming)
1 14 40 -60 20 1 0 0 0 0.866 0.5 0 -0.5 0.866 parts/100662.dat

0 // -- FIGURE 2: THE SHIELD (Middle Row) --
0 // Arms up, Static legs
0 // Hips
1 1 80 0 -100 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/16709.dat
0 // Torso
1 1 80 -32 -100 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/12896.dat
0 // Head
1 14 80 -56 -100 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/12607.dat
0 // Arms (Abstracted with spacing or simple bricks if parts unavailable,
0 // but using Torso implies arms attached. We rely on imagination here).

0 // -- FIGURE 3: THE FLEE (Back Row) --
0 // Turned away (Rotated Y 180)
0 // Hips
1 320 120 0 100 -1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 -1 parts/19859.dat
0 // Torso
1 320 120 -32 100 -1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 -1 parts/16360.dat
0 // Head
1 3 120 -56 100 -1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 -1 parts/13195p01.dat

0 // -- THE LUGGAGE OBSTACLES --
0 // Crates scattered
1 14 60 0 -50 0.9 0 0.4 0 1 0 -0.4 0 0.9 parts/4345ap03.dat
1 72 90 0 150 0.7 0 -0.7 0 1 0 0.7 0 0.7 parts/956.dat

0 NOFILE
